raiz.texto: An autistic cognitive architecture that prioritizes local sensory detail over global coherence, operates through concrete-visual representations, requires explicit rule structures, and regulates learning through predictable, closed-loop feedback, with hyperfocused, effortful attention regulation, and emotionally dysregulated, alexithymic affective processing, with delayed developmental timing and slowed complex processing.
